thought.text: JDK 21 installed. Let me pre-fetch the openapi-generator 7.10.0 jar (pinned by the app) and restart `pnpm install` with `JAVA_HOME` set:

reasoning_content:
The app pins openapi-generator 7.10.0. The CLI will download the 7.10.0 jar (about 15MB) from repo1.maven.org. Let's pre-fetch this jar to a location where the CLI can find it (or let it download). Let me check how the CLI finds the jar — it's downloaded to `node_modules/@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/versions/`. I could also pre-fetch it by specifying `storageDir` via openapitools.json, but... let's not over-engineer this. If I run it, it should download the 15MB jar at the throttled speed (~100 seconds). That's fine.

Actually, let me pre-download the jar in parallel and place it where the CLI expects it. The CLI's storage directory: `node_modules/@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/versions`. The filename is openapi-generator-cli-7.10.0.jar. Let me check the jar URL: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/7.10.0/openapi-generator-cli-7.10.0.jar

Let's pre-fetch that in the background, and set JAVA_HOME and restart pnpm install.

action.command:
nohup curl -sSL -o /tmp/openapi-gen-7.10.0.jar --max-time 590 "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/7.10.0/openapi-generator-cli-7.10.0.jar" > /tmp/opapi-dl.log 2>&1 &
echo "jar dl pid $!"; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/ 2>/dev/null | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "nohup curl -sSL -o /tmp/openapi-gen-7.10.0.jar --max-time 590 \"https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/7.10.0/openapi-generator-cli-7.10.0.jar\" > /tmp/opapi-dl.log 2>&1 &\necho \"jar dl pid $!\"; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/ 2>/dev/null | head", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Pre-fetch openapi-generator jar in background"}
